intervals.label: installation and first experimental season
intervals.note: The abstract of this copy of the paper prints the detector name as KMD-3; the body text of the same paper names it CMD3 (section 5). The first experimental season was completed in summer 2010.
intervals.quote: In October 2009, a KMD-3 (cryogenic magnetic detector) was installed at the VEPP-2000 facility ... This first experimental season was completed in summer 2010 with precision energy calibration by resonant depolarization.

intervals.quote: VEPP-2000 e+e− collider at BINP was commissioned and started data taking with two detectors in 2010 with old injection chain.

solenoid_field.note: Range 1.0-1.3 T; the maximum is recorded.

summary.plain: The CMD-3 detector: a superconducting solenoid around the collision point with a drift chamber, time-of-flight counters, three types of calorimeter and muon counters, measuring the products of electron-positron collisions at up to 2 GeV.
summary.technical: CMD-3: magnetic field 1.0-1.3 T; drift chamber (σ ~100 µm in the transverse plane, 2-3 mm along z); EM calorimeter (LXe, CsI, BGO, 13.5 X0, σ_E/E ~3-10%); TOF; muon counters.

technology.locator: Solodov, Phi to Psi 2026, slide 3 (CMD-3 detector)
technology.value: Magnetic detector with a drift chamber, time-of-flight counters, an electromagnetic calorimeter of liquid xenon, CsI and BGO and muon counters in a 1.0-1.3 T field
